description: This file defines an abstract class CommandConsumer that wraps an AMQP receiver link for consuming commands, including methods for creating tracing spans and logging command information.

classes.name: CommandConsumer
classes.description: An abstract class that wraps an AMQP receiver link for consuming commands and provides tracing and logging functionalities.

methods.name: createSpan
methods.description: Creates and starts an OpenTracing span for command consumer operations, tagging span with tenant, device, and optionally gateway IDs.

methods.name: logReceivedCommandToSpan
methods.description: Logs details of a received command message to the provided tracing span, including validation and error logging.
